start_group:
👋 I'm online! Use /play <song> to stream music in the voice chat.
Type /help to see everything I can do.
start_group_added:
Thanks for adding me to **{chat}**! 🎵

Make sure my assistant {assistant} is also in this group, then start a voice chat and use `/play <song>`.
help_text:
**Shion — Command Reference**

**🎵 Streaming**
• /play - stream audio (name or YouTube link)
• /vplay - stream video
• /playforce - clear queue & play now
• /vplayforce - video variant
• /pause - pause the stream
• /resume - resume playback
• /skip - skip to the next track
• /seek <1:30> - jump inside the track
• /stop - stop playback and clear the queue

**📋 Queue**
• /queue - show the current queue
• /queue clear - empty the queue
• /loop <n|off> - repeat the current track

**ℹ️ Info**
• /ping - latency & uptime
• /stats - resource metrics
• /settings - language & options
• /id - chat / user ids

**🛡 Admin**
• /auth /unauth /authusers - delegate playback rights

Powered by the Testweb3 streaming engine.
settings_text:
**⚙️ Settings for this chat**

Choose a language or toggle automatic command deletion:
fetch_failed: ⚠️ Could not resolve a stream for this track. Try again in a moment.
no_stream: ⚠️ The streaming engine did not return a playable stream for this item.
duration_limit: ⚠️ **{title}** is {duration} long — the limit here is {limit} minutes.
queue_full: ⚠️ The queue is full ({limit} tracks). Please wait for the current songs to finish.
nothing_playing: ❌ Nothing is playing in this chat.
stopped: ⏹ Playback stopped and the queue was cleared.
loop_set: 🔁 Loop enabled — the current track repeats **{n}** time(s).
seek_failed: ⚠️ Seek failed — nothing is playing or the position is invalid.
only_group: ❌ This command only works in groups.
assistant_missing:
⚠️ My assistant {assistant} is not in this chat yet.

Please add **{assistant}** to the group (as a member or admin) and try again.
admin_only: 🚫 This command is reserved for admins.
sudo_only: 🚫 This command is reserved for my owner & sudo users.
owner_only: 🚫 This command is reserved for my owner.
error: ❌ Something went wrong — please try again.
auth_added: ✅ {user} can now control playback in this chat.
auth_missing_user: Reply to a user or provide their id/username.
auth_list_empty: 📭 No authorised users in this chat.
